name: Tilal Binghatti
headline: Where the Hills Meet the Skyline
summary: Binghatti's fluted architectural signature brought down to earth, across a 621,815+ sqm Phase 1 masterplan of 4 to 6 bedroom villas and mansions.
description: Tilal Binghatti takes its name from the Arabic word for hills — a residence defined by the same fluted, sculptural facades that have made Binghatti's skyline instantly recognisable, set within reach of the city's everyday rhythm.
For the first time, Binghatti's architectural signature takes root in the soil across a 621,815+ sqm Phase 1 masterplan: a self-contained, walkable district of 4 to 6 bedroom villas and mansions.

Every residence shares the same brief: 4M floor-to-ceiling heights, 8M double-height living areas, and a material palette of marble, wood veneer and champagne hairline metal that carries from the facade into each home.

highlights.title: Delivered Landscaped Gardens
highlights.text: Villas hand over grass-landscaped, not sand — no post-handover finishing burden.

highlights.title: Prime Location
highlights.text: 10 minutes from Meydan Racecourse and Dubai's Downtown-bound road network.

highlights.title: 50+ Amenities
highlights.text: Pearl Beach, Alwaha swimmable lakes, a clubhouse and a 1.6km cycling & jogging track.

highlights.title: 20,000+ Trees
highlights.text: Central parks, green corridors and shaded walkways across the masterplan.

highlights.title: The Sunken Pearl
highlights.text: A 12,000 sqm artificial shore with a wave-generation system.

highlights.title: Smart Home & Security
highlights.text: Integrated smart home technology, EV charging and gated, secure clusters.
